map.支持四象限羊水指数（AFI）与最大垂直羊水池（MVP）两种测量模式，快速判断羊水: Supports four-quadrant AFI and maximal vertical pocket (MVP) modes to quickly judge amniotic fluid volume.
map.📖 查看「羊水指数（AFI）正常范围 使用指南」: 📖 View "Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range User Guide"
map.AFI = 四象限羊水池深度之和；MVP = 最大垂直羊水池深度: AFI = sum of four-quadrant pocket depths; MVP = deepest vertical pocket depth
map.AFI < 5 cm 羊水过少、5–8 cm 临界、8–25 cm 正常、> 2: AFI <5 cm oligohydramnios, 5-8 cm borderline, 8-25 cm normal, >25 cm polyhydramnios; MVP <2 too low, 2-8 normal, >8 too high.
map.💡 参考标准：AFI ＜5 cm 羊水过少，5~8 cm 临界，8~25 cm: 💡 Reference: AFI <5 cm oligohydramnios, 5-8 cm borderline, 8-25 cm normal, >25 cm polyhydramnios; MVP <2 cm oligohydramnios, 2-8 cm normal, >8 cm polyhydramnios.
map.AFI 与 MVP 各有优劣，临床常结合孕周与胎儿情况综合判断。: AFI and MVP each have pros/cons; clinicians often combine with gestational age and fetal status.
map.羊水异常需排除胎膜早破、胎儿畸形、胎盘功能减退等病因。: Abnormal fluid needs to exclude PROM, fetal anomaly, placental insufficiency, etc.
map.超声测 AFI 判断羊水量是否正常。: Ultrasound measures AFI to judge whether fluid is normal.
map.AFI 临界或异常时决定复查与干预。: At borderline/abnormal AFI, decide recheck and intervention.
map.四象限 4+4+5+3 = 16cm，落在 8–25cm 正常区间，继续常规产检: Four quadrants 4+4+5+3 = 16 cm, within 8-25 cm normal; continue routine care.
map.AFI 4.5cm（<5）：判羊水过少，排查胎膜早破与泌尿系统畸形，足月可考虑终: AFI 4.5 cm (<5): oligohydramnios; rule out PROM and urinary anomalies; at term consider delivery.
map.AFI 正常范围是多少？: What is the normal AFI range?
map.一般 8–25cm 为正常；5–8cm 临界偏少、<5cm 过少、>25cm 过: Generally 8-25 cm normal; 5-8 cm borderline low, <5 cm low, >25 cm high; guidelines vary slightly.
map.过少和过多分别警惕什么？: What do low and high each warn about?
map.过少警惕胎膜早破、胎儿畸形、胎盘功能减退；过多警惕妊娠期糖尿病、胎儿消化道畸形，: Low warns of PROM, fetal anomaly, placental insufficiency; high warns of GDM, fetal GI anomaly; both need further evaluation.

map.支持四象限羊水指数（AFI）和最大垂直羊水池（MVP）两种常用超声评估方法，自动: Supports four-quadrant AFI and MVP, the two common ultrasound methods, to auto-judge oligohydramnios, borderline, normal or polyhydramnios.
